header: Everyone who could get to Hollerau on the same Friday
lead: Taken in the yard behind the Bahnhofstraße office in June, an hour before the anniversary lunch and twenty minutes before it started raining.
caption: The Aubruck team, June 2024. Six people are missing: four were on sites and two had the day off, which is roughly the office's normal ratio.
note: Back row, left to right: Hanno Grasser, Paul Ebner, Norbert Pichlmayr, Emre Aydin, Milan Hrdlicka, Roland Lachner, Tobias Reindl. Middle row: Renate Söllner, Sabine Wolkersdorfer, Clara Hofstätter, Nadja Reithofer, Christoph Waldner, Firat Yildiz. Front row: Doris Achleitner, Katja Sunder, Marlene Ostermann, Gerhard Tulln, Andrea Brandstätter, Anja Feuerstein, Lea Wimmer.
